# VENDOR-022 — Qualcomm Oryon Flex Cache

## 30-second read
Qualcomm publicly positions its next premium mobile CPU around:
- CPU orchestration for Agentic AI;
- a Flex Cache pool shared by heterogeneous CPU cores;
- dynamic cache allocation;
- keeping large working sets resident as work hands off between cores.

This is strong product-direction evidence, not independent proof of Agent-specific performance value.

See deep.md.
